steps.what: Monitor food temperatures using the prescribed measurement procedure
outputs: measured food temperatures and batch context

steps.what: Record measured food temperatures with time batch and location
inputs: measured food temperatures and batch context

steps.what: Check readings against procedure and act on food temperature exceptions

tasks.design: Configure a food-safety log in {OTHER} hygiene registration software with reusable batch/location choices and timestamps. The cook still measures temperatures, enters the reading, checks the record and follows the approved exception procedure; no sensor replaces food measurement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing repeated context and organising paper logs adds effort to required measurements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native registration forms can reuse context and flag missing entries.
tasks.still_hard: Taking representative readings and responding appropriately when conditions are uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising that a plausible number may come from an incorrect measurement.
tasks.altitude: Less log administration; measurement and food-safety responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the response to an unusual measurement or missing record
reach.learn: Which details establish a meaningful measurement

evidence.claim: Hygiënecode Online provides HACCP registration and warns about missed measurements; it supports testing native logs, not the estimated saving.
The proposed logging reduction is unmeasured and retains physical measurement time.

assumptions: Boundary is temperature measurement, recording and immediate response; broader food preparation and equipment maintenance are outside it.
The cook produces the actual reading and batch/location context in s1, retaining all sampling and measurement time.

s2 counts entry of batch ID, food/location, measured temperature, unit, measurement time and operator reference; timestamps default only when measurement is contemporaneous and are corrected otherwise.
No free structured measurement feed is assumed. Missing fields or offline operation use the existing manual log, with later entry inside the retained logging/exception allowance.
Test native registration first; approved procedures supply limits through unchanged food-safety governance and do not come from a model.
Consultation and access depend on local employee-recording arrangements; current system runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Current log format, measurement volumes and native application support
research_questions: Does the form reduce repeated context entry after counting all measurement capture and offline corrections?

already_counted.description: Reading entry and manual/offline corrections in s2
Checking and exception response in s3

incremental.description: Maintain local log choices and inspect missed-entry problems
Maintain approved form and limit configuration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+12.5+15=87.5; gross 12.5 minus 1 focal upkeep gives net 11.5. High requires repeated context and reliable entry; low covers offline logs and corrections consuming the benefit. Food-safety lead upkeep is separate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect food supplies dates condition and required storage locations
Rotate and store food supplies in the correct locations

tasks.design: Retain direct inspection, rotation and placement of food. Existing {OTHER} kitchen stock software may show records, but a record does not replace checking the pack and moving it into suitable storage.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task depends on actual pack condition and physical placement.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional digital input removes the physical work in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged labels, unexpected conditions and unsuitable storage space.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising a discrepancy between a record and the actual food.
tasks.altitude: No change to food rotation and storage duties.

reach.task: Resolve supplies whose condition or storage suitability is uncertain
reach.learn: When to segregate or escalate under the approved procedure

evidence.claim: Physical food checks and movement remain human work with no claimed software saving.

assumptions: Boundary excludes ordering, stock reporting and preparation.
s1 produces checked dates, condition and storage needs; no structured expiry or storage flag is assumed.
s2 retains all movement and placement; existing stock-record capture remains unchanged.
No new system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Storage layout, pack types and current stock records
research_questions: Is there actual duplicate stock entry outside the physical rotation task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+65=100. Inspection and physical rotation retain full time; incremental upkeep is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct meal preparation and serving assistants

steps.what: Direct workers assisting meal preparation and serving as kitchen conditions change

tasks.design: Keep live direction of assistants with the cook. An existing {DOCS} meal plan supports the conversation, but no extra schedule-production workload is assumed inside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction depends on immediate kitchen conditions and workers' understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No reliable substitute for live supervision is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Adjusting to delays, errors and changing serving needs.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing when an assistant needs clarification or practical help.

reach.task: Resolve staffing or service conflicts beyond the cook's authority

evidence.claim: Live kitchen direction remains human work without a claimed automation saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the cook's direction, excluding assistants' own preparation/serving time.
s1 includes observing current progress and communicating directions; no structured worker-readiness feed is assumed.
Existing meal plans and staffing arrangements remain unchanged; no new capture is shifted to assistants.
No new system or ongoing upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Is a separate repetitive administrative burden present beyond live direction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100. All live direction remains; no system or incremental upkeep is proposed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Train new employees by explaining and demonstrating kitchen work
Observe new employee practice and provide corrective training feedback

tasks.design: Retain practical explanation, demonstration and feedback with the cook. Existing {DOCS} procedures can remain available as references, but a generated lesson does not establish that a new employee can carry out the task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning practical kitchen work needs observed practice and correction.
tasks.enabler_now: No separate material-authoring burden is established in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting explanations and spotting unsafe habits before independent work.
tasks.human_edge: Judging understanding through real work rather than completion of a screen.
tasks.altitude: No change to practical training responsibility.

reach.task: Arrange further support when a new employee is not ready
reach.learn: Which practical skills require more supervised practice

evidence.claim: Practical demonstration and observation remain human work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is the cook's practical training, excluding employee practice time and unrelated onboarding administration.
The cook identifies learning needs and observes practice during retained s1/s2 time; no structured competence score is assumed.
Existing approved procedures are unchanged inputs; no new authoring or employee capture is transferred.
No additional system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Training mix, employee needs and existing reference material
research_questions: Is repeated preparation of training material a separate measured task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100. Demonstration and corrective feedback retain their time, with zero incremental upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce temperature-log administration while retaining food handling and practical leadership.
reach: Share clear exceptions with kitchen and food-safety leads
role.ambitious_version: Keep meal service safe and well coordinated with less repeated logging.
